description: Adds twelve polyphonic inputs, each one switched to add, to subtract or to be left out

params.text: Three way switch: minus subtracts its input from the sum, 0 leaves that input out, plus adds it; it starts on 0

inputs.text: One of the twelve inputs; the switch beside it sets whether it is added, subtracted or left out

outputs.text: The inputs that are switched in, added together, with as many channels as the widest input
